Override.AttributionNote: 萬如禪師語錄, tower inscription for Wanru Tongwei. Gao Shitai is the exact author: the inscription closes with his full signature 高世泰敬讔并書, and the stored verse says Wanru effaced forms and cut entangling vines while raising the kalavinka amid the eon-fire.
